conviction_note: Mild long: by inference from the company's own Q1 numbers, revenue beats a ~$826M bar that implies only ~8.5% organic growth against a Q1 underlying run-rate of 10-12% on a similar comp. Both prior prints (rev beat, EPS miss in Q1) were bought >10%. The stock is -11.5% into the print at its post-Q1 low with ~3.5% short interest. The open risk is the margin line (9.9% Q1 adj EBITDA vs a 16% underlying FY target) plus the already-filed $162M charge that drops the headline margin guide to ~11.3%. p_up 57 on an 11% abs move gives +1.5. That sits a little below the +1.7 findings sum because the revenue finding is inference, not a disclosed number.
bar: Revenue about $825-828M for fiscal Q2 FY27 (quarter ended 2026-10-30). Earnings Whispers $827.5M / EPS $0.10 (https://finviz.com/news/423377/minimeds-second-standalone-quarter-must-show-flex-demand-can-outrun-fading-margin-patience, 2026-11-16). Yahoo $825.3M / EPS $0.12 (9 and 7 analysts) and Benzinga $825.6M / EPS $0.12, as reported in search snippets of https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/quote/MMED/analysis/ and https://www.benzinga.com/quote/MMED/earnings-forecasts. Revenue: two-plus agreeing sources. EPS: sources disagree ($0.10 vs $0.12). Company guide: FY27 organic growth ~10.5% including a 1.0-1.5pt extra-week benefit, FY revenue ~$3.43B, adj EBITDA margin ~16% underlying, restated to ~11.3% after the $162M Fit milestone charge (8-K 2026-11-16).
positioning_check: Short interest (FINRA settlements via https://equibles.com/stocks/mmed/shortinterest): 9.81M shares on 2026-10-30, down from 20.7M on 2026-10-15. The Oct-15 figure was exchange-offer arbitrage that covered with the delivered shares (https://protos.com/how-minimed-ended-up-with-99-of-its-float-sold-short/, 2026-10-08). On ~281M shares out that is ~3.5%, ~1.5 days at the 6.7M 20d average volume, so the short is not crowded. Skew: the baseline 25d skew is null and put/call OI is 0.12 (call-heavy). The ATM spread is 76% of mid, so the 10.46% implied move is indicative only. Tape: -11.45% over 5 days, -11.5% over 20 days, 30.7% off the 52w high. Spot $16.515 is at or below the $16.56 post-Q1 low cited by Earnings Whispers, whose preview called sentiment 'clearly bearish'. Barclays cut its PT to $20 from $22 on 2026-11-13. A supply overhang exists: 252.8M MMED shares went on 2026-10-15 to tendering MDT holders, an offer 5.4x oversubscribed.

findings.finding: The revenue bar of ~$826M implies about 9.3% reported growth on the $757M prior-year quarter (Medtronic Diabetes Q2 FY26), or ~8.5% organic after ~0.8pt FX. In Q1 FY27 underlying organic growth was low double digits: 15.8% organic less a 4-6pt extra week. That came on a comparable comp (Q2 FY26 organic +7.1% with the US soft ahead of sensor launches, vs Q1 FY26 +7.9%), and Q2 is the first full quarter of US Flex+Instinct shipments (from mid-August). Holding Q1's underlying ~10-12% organic gives ~$839-855M, a 1.5-3.5% beat.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 FY27 (2026-09-01): revenue $843M vs ~$828M consensus (+1.8%), EPS missed per Earnings Whispers, FY organic guide raised 10% to 10.5%; stock +10.66%. Q4 FY26 (2026-06-03): +15.93%. Both prints up, so revenue and guide have paid on this name.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus sits ~$16M below Q1's $843M and below even a flat-underlying-growth path. Earnings Whispers notes FY consensus $3.42B is still under the company's own $3.43B guide, so the Street has not adopted the raise. If the market priced an above-bar quarter, the stock would not sit at its post-Q1 low after -11.5% in five days with 'clearly bearish' sentiment.
findings.independence: The prior-year base comes from a different document: Medtronic Q2 FY26 release, Diabetes $757M, +7.1% organic, US soft awaiting sensors (https://news.medtronic.com/2025-11-18-Medtronic-reports-strong-second-quarter-fiscal-2026-financial-results,-enterprise-growth-drivers-accelerate-momentum). The Q1 underlying US growth of 'high single digit' and >20% new-pump growth come from the Wells Fargo conference summary (https://quartr.com/events/minimed-group-inc-mmed-wells-fargo-21st-annual-healthcare-conference_FRZFcShK, 2026-09-08). This is an inference from company numbers, not a disclosed Q2 figure.

findings.finding: Insulet (2026-11-04) reported US new customer starts flat year over year after a record Q4 2025 and its second-best Q2. It guided Q4 US Omnipod growth down to 10-13.5% and pre-cut 2027. Tandem (2026-11-05) had US pump revenue -1.7% even as shipments rose to ~23k from ~20k. Both reports landed during MiniMed's fiscal Q2 (Aug-Oct), the first full quarter of Flex.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior MMED reaction to a peer read-through on record. Q1's US new-pump growth >20% with over half from patients new to MiniMed was part of the +10.66% print.
findings.why_not_priced: MMED fell rather than rose after the peers' early-November prints, and previews still frame the quarter as a test of whether Q1 was pent-up demand. If the read-through were priced, MMED would have outperformed PODD into its own print. Sized small: Insulet attributes its lost starts to 'new tubeless competitors', not explicitly to MiniMed, and Tandem's shipments rose, so the AID market is not shrinking.
findings.independence: Tandem Q3 2026 8-K: US pump sales $83.4M, -1.7% YoY; shipments ~23k (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001438133/000143813326000143/ex991-q3earningsrelease2026.htm). This is a peer proxy, not a MiniMed number.

findings.finding: The 8-K of 2026-11-16 has two parts. MiniMed Fit (tubeless, 7-day) was cleared by FDA, pulling the US launch forward to spring 2027 from summer 2027. Clearance also triggers a one-time $162M charge in fiscal Q3 under the Blackstone Life Sciences R&D agreement. MiniMed includes that charge in adjusted EBITDA, so the FY27 adj EBITDA margin guide falls to ~11.3% from ~16%. The company says nothing changes underlying, and cash is paid over time on sales. Tomorrow's release will carry the ~11.3% headline guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The identical Flex charge ($157M, Q4 FY26, 8-K 2026-03-25) was followed by the Q4 FY26 print at +15.93%. The stock rose 3.7% on 2026-11-16 and fell 4.66% on 2026-11-17.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the 8-K is public and the stock has fallen ~11% since. The residual is headline and screen risk at the open from a printed 'adj EBITDA margin ~11.3%' guide against the 16% many models carry. The royalty-or-minimum structure also implies a mid-to-high single-digit royalty drag on Fit sales for two years, which a reader may push into FY28 margins.
findings.independence: The Flex precedent and Blackstone royalty structure are in a separate 8-K (https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/MMED/8-k-mini-med-group-inc-reports-material-event-c1d8090f867e.html, 2026-03-25). The Fit clearance and launch timing are confirmed by Quiver (https://www.quiverquant.com/news/MiniMed+Gains+After+FDA+Clears+Tubeless+Pump+and+Pulls+Launch+Timeline+Forward). One 8-K, so the clearance and the charge are one finding.

findings.finding: The margin line is the open risk. Q1 adj EBITDA margin was 9.9% (12.2% ex an $8M pull-forward and an FX remeasurement charge) against a ~16% FY underlying target, reaffirmed but not raised and back-half weighted. Q1 FCF was -$90M on separation costs, and only 17 of ~160 Medtronic TSAs had been exited. EPS consensus ($0.10-0.12) needs a sequential margin step-up in a quarter that carries the post-Oct-15 standalone cost base.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 FY27 EPS missed consensus ($0.09 estimate per Earnings Whispers) and the stock still rose 10.66% on revenue and the guide, so this name has looked through an EPS and margin miss once.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the preview names it as the key worry and sentiment is bearish. What is not priced is a second consecutive sub-12% margin quarter with a steeper H2 ramp. That would leave the underlying 16% target implausible and could force a cut to the underlying number beyond the charge.
findings.independence: Quartr Q1 call summary: margin expansion expected in H2; Simplera carries lower margin (https://quartr.com/events/minimed-group-inc-mmed-q1-2027_FRZFccQY). Same company source family.

findings.finding: Abbott (Q3, 2026-10-21) cut its diabetes outlook to low-to-mid single digit growth for Q4 and likely the next few quarters, citing no new CGM reimbursement expansion and 'pricing adjustments' to secure longer contracts. Global CGM sales grew 7.7% comparable. Abbott makes MiniMed's Instinct sensor, and CGM attach (69% worldwide) is part of MiniMed's recurring revenue.
findings.why_not_priced: Abbott's cut came before MMED's -11.8% slide since Q1, so it may already sit in the price. What remains is whether MiniMed signals CGM pricing pressure on its Simplera sensor in its outlook. Proxy only: MiniMed's sensors ride on its pump base, not on standalone CGM reimbursement.
findings.independence: Abbott Q3 release: CGM sales +7.7% comparable (https://finviz.com/news/405133/abbott-reports-third-quarter-2026-results-and-reaffirms-full-year-eps-guidance). This is macro-to-company transmission that MiniMed has not confirmed.

findings.finding: Positioning into the print: the stock is -11.45% over 5 days and -11.5% over 20 days, at $16.515 vs the $16.56 post-Q1 low. Short interest is low (9.8M shares, ~3.5% of shares out, ~1.5 days on 2026-10-30) after the exchange-offer arbitrage shorts (20.7M on Oct 15) covered. Barclays cut its PT to $20 on 2026-11-13. Both prior prints rose >10%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Two of two prints up, +10.66% and +15.93%.
findings.why_not_priced: This is the price itself, so it is not unpriced information. It argues for asymmetry: expectations have been reset lower, and a clean revenue quarter starts from a washed-out tape. Sized small because the drawdown has no single documented cause beyond the Nov-16 charge and possible flowback from the 252.8M shares delivered to former MDT holders.
findings.independence: Earnings Whispers: sentiment 'clearly bearish', stock near its post-earnings low (https://www.earningswhispers.com/article/MMED/23229). Medtronic exchange-offer final results: 252,813,348 MMED shares delivered, 5.4x oversubscribed (https://news.medtronic.com/2026-10-14-Medtronic-Announces-Final-Results-of-MiniMed-Group,-Inc-Exchange-Offer).

findings.finding: Tandem received FDA clearance on 2026-11-13 for a tubeless, 7-day-wear cartridge that converts the existing Mobi pump, launching 1H 2027 through pharmacy. Its timing matches MiniMed Fit's spring-2027 launch, so the tubeless category MiniMed is entering gets a second entrant at the same time, alongside Omnipod.
findings.why_not_priced: Public for 10 days and likely in the price. It matters only if management's call commentary on Fit share or pricing is pressed on it.
findings.independence: MedTech Dive coverage of the same clearance (https://www.medtechdive.com/news/tandem-wins-fda-clearance-for-tubeless-automated-insulin-delivery-system/874718/). Same event.

outside_window.finding: MiniMed Fit US launch in spring 2027 through pharmacy, with Blackstone royalty-or-minimum payments over the first two years. The commercial uptake and margin drag land after this window.

baseline_tension: The long lean cuts against the -11.5% run-up. It agrees with the call-heavy OI (put/call 0.12), and there is no skew number to contradict it (null). The tension is the tape: the market has spent a week selling into the print, and I cannot fully explain it beyond the Nov-16 guide restatement.
lessons_applied: Lesson 3 (own caveat reaches the number): the Insulet/Tandem read-through goes from +0.8 to +0.5, because Insulet attributes its lost starts to tubeless entrants rather than MiniMed and Tandem shipments rose.
Lesson 5 (an unexplained drawdown is not a cause): the positioning finding goes from +1.0 to +0.5, because the slide has no fully documented cause and a washed-out tape is not information.
Lessons 1 and 6 left the revenue finding at +2.5: the revenue bar has two-plus agreeing sources, and this name has paid for revenue beats (+10.66%, +15.93%), even after an EPS miss.
Lesson 2: the $162M charge stays a small one_off (-0.3), since the company says the underlying guide is unchanged and cash is paid over time.
